scope: Bibliographic metadata and directed citation edges for research; no HTML, full text, citation contexts or recommendations

openalex.authentication: OPENALEX_API_KEY query parameter when configured; basic unauthenticated queries supported subject to provider limits
openalex.quota_policy: At least one second between requests plus configured request budget. Free API usage is limited; do not assume unlimited requests.
openalex.license: CC0 data; API access subject to provider limits
openalex.pagination: Forward cursor pagination; backward referenced_works list with metadata batches of at most 100
openalex.limitation: Indexed relationships only; missing hydrated records retained as unresolved metadata

semantic_scholar.authentication: SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY in x-api-key when configured; public endpoints share a throttled unauthenticated pool
semantic_scholar.quota_policy: Introductory authenticated limit is 1 request/second; bounded retries respect Retry-After
semantic_scholar.license: Semantic Scholar API License Agreement; research workflow; attribute Semantic Scholar in published outputs
semantic_scholar.pagination: references and citations data arrays with next offsets; maximum requested page size 1000
semantic_scholar.limitation: Null endpoints retained; shared unauthenticated throttling may prevent a complete pilot

opencitations.authentication: OPENCITATIONS_ACCESS_TOKEN in authorization when configured; token encouraged
opencitations.quota_policy: Documented 180 requests/minute/IP; implementation uses at most 1 request/second
opencitations.pagination: Index v2 returns one JSON list; no invented pagination. Relationship cap is applied locally and does not bound HTTP response size.
opencitations.fields: OCI, citing/cited identifiers; Meta bibliographic fields
opencitations.limitation: Total is unknown unless independently supplied; metadata hydration failures are retained
